program_exit_zero.absent_condition_reason: The same gate OPENS with a hard `files_exist: [phase3/stage3/pnr/spare_cells.json]` clause, so an absent spare-cell manifest FAILs step 18 at that predicate before this clause is reached. The condition removes a duplicate failure; it hides none.

canonical_row.notes:
Spare-cell-array insertion is the cornerstone of Design-for-ECO:
it pre-budgets unused, distributed, tied-off standard cells so a
late-stage functional bug can be fixed with a metal-only ECO
(re-wiring existing spares) instead of a full base-layer re-spin.
The cells look like dead logic and WILL be stripped by any
optimizer unless protected — the runner marks every spare with a
keep / dont_touch attribute and excludes them from opt_clean /
clean -purge / remove_buffers / repair_design, and Step 34 metal
fill is constrained not to overlap or delete them.

canonical_row.name: Parasitic Extraction (RC → SPEF)
canonical_row.notes:
Coupling tiers (increasing accuracy, all DISCLOSED, none foundry-calibrated):
(1) grounded-cap — OpenRCX v2 `-lef_rc` from tech-LEF R + area + fringe.
(2) analytical lateral coupling — `_spef_coupling` parallel-plate Cc from
    routed DEF geometry + generic 180nm dielectric (the default augment).
(3) FIELD-SOLVED coupling — `pdk_dielectric_fit` inverts the PDK's own
    area+fringe cap to a fitted dielectric stack, then `fastercap_extract`
    runs the OSS 3D BEM solver FasterCap on the routed geometry (lateral
    + inter-layer crossover the analytical model misses). Opt-in
    (eda_extraction field_solve); self-reports NOT_APPLICABLE if the
    solver is absent — never a fabricated matrix. Foundry field-solve
    (`rules.C`/`.nxtgrd`) + crosstalk-SI sign-off remain a foundry-data gap.
